results.question: Looking only two pipe connections downstream of pump P4711, what do you reach, and is that where the line ends?
results.answer:
Two pipe connections downstream of pump P4711 lead to GlobeValve 47123/C1 (GlobeValve-2) [E2.2].  
The first connection is from P4711 to the plate heat exchanger H1007 on line 47122, DN 80 [E2.3].  
The second connection is from H1007 to GlobeValve 47123/C1 on line 47123, DN 80 [E2.4].  
GlobeValve 47123/C1 is not marked as terminal and the traversal indicates the piping continues beyond this point [E2.2].  
Therefore, after two pipe connections downstream of P4711 you reach GlobeValve 47123/C1, and the line does not end there. [E2.2, E2.3, E2.4]
